title: Request for Offerors (RFO) for Delivery of firm load following electric supply service at the William J. Hughes Technical Center (WJHTC) Atlantic City International Airport, NJ
agency: TRANSPORTATION, DEPARTMENT OF.FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION.692L79 DOT FAA TECHNICAL CENTER
description_text: The Federal Aviation Administration Real Estate Office currently has a requirement fors for the delivery of firm load following electric supply services, including electric energy, ancillary services, ARR credits, PJM marginal losses, NJ Renewable Portfolio Standards, Transmission Enhancement Charge,FERC Order 745 charges, balancing congestion charges, RMR charges, and capacity and transmission services to the William J. Hughes Technical Center (WJHTC) located at the Atlantic City International Airport, Atlantic City, NJ 08401 All required RFO documents are attached
